title: The Honest Farmer
request: refine my script about the honest farmer

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A poor farmer found *100* gold coins on an empty road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody saw him. And nobody would ever know.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: His name was Tomas. He worked his field from morning until night, and his family still went hungry.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That morning, on the way to market, a heavy bag lay on the road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Inside was more money than he had seen in his whole life.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He thought about his hungry children. He thought about his broken roof.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then he saw the mark on the bag. It was the *queen's*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For 3 days, Tomas could not sleep.

lines.speaker: wife
lines.text: Keep the gold! The queen is rich. She will never miss it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the third night, he made his decision.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He walked all the way to the castle.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The soldiers at the gate laughed at his old clothes.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: I have something that belongs to the queen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The queen counted the coins. All 100 were there.

lines.speaker: queen
lines.text: Why did you not keep it? Nobody would have known.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: *I* would have known.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The queen was quiet for a long time.

lines.speaker: queen
lines.text: I lost that bag on purpose. I wanted to find one *honest* person in my kingdom.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She trusted Tomas to look after the royal treasure.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And she gave him 10 gold coins every month, for the rest of his life.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the village, they still say it. An honest man sleeps well, even on a *hard* bed.

changes: Opening moved: the video now starts with the farmer finding the 100 gold coins, the most striking moment, instead of a greeting.
"Nobody was on the road and nobody had seen him" moved up into the opening, as "Nobody saw him. And nobody would ever know."
The greeting ("Hello everyone, today I am going to tell you...") and "Thank you for watching" were cut.
"Once upon a time, in a small village near a big castle" was cut; the castle appears when Tomas walks to it.
The 44-word sentence about Tomas and his field became two short sentences.
The 38-word sentence about finding the bag became three short lines.
Five pieces of reported speech became spoken lines: his wife's advice, Tomas at the gate, the queen's question, his answer, and her reason.
"The queen was very surprised when she saw the bag" was cut; her face shows it.
The last line was split in two so the saying stands alone.
Every fact is kept: 100 coins, 3 days, the queen's mark, the soldiers laughing, all 100 coins returned, 10 coins a month for life.
